body: For sanity, I tested this on 4.7 stable and the issue is present.

To be specific, this happens if there has been any previous calls, not necessarily from `_ready()`. Also, using `call_deferred` fixes this, so it only happens on the frame of the change if there has been any previous reads.

> To be specific, this happens if there has been any previous calls, not necessarily from `_ready()`. Also, using `call_deferred` fixes this, so it only happens on the frame of the change if there has been any previous reads.

Should I change the title?

Can reproduce on 4.7, and it is not unique to `_ready()`

If trying to read, set, and read again:
```gdscript
func _on_button_pressed() -> void:
	prints("Label font size:", get_theme_font_size("font_size", "Label"))
	theme.set_font_size("font_size", "Label", 24)
	prints("Label font size:", get_theme_font_size("font_size", "Label"))
```
Result:
```
Label font size: 16
Label font size: 16
```

If setting and reading immediately:
```gdscript
func _on_button_pressed() -> void:
	theme.set_font_size("font_size", "Label", 24)
	prints("Label font size:", get_theme_font_size("font_size", "Label"))
```
Result:
```
Label font size: 24
```

After first read, the theme value is cached inside Control. Once new theme value is set, theme sends `changed` signal, which Control turns into `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED`. The cache is invalidated once `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` is received. However, Control connects to `changed` signal from theme in deferred way, so it takes some time from actual theme change to notification about theme change. So until Control processes `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED`, the returned value will be incorrect. Another thing is that `theme_changed` signal is sent before theme value cache invalidation, so some small time has to be waited, or waiting for `theme_changed` in deferred way also works.

I am not sure what would be the best way to fix it or provide better ways to handle it, as this looks like intended behaviour and can be fixed in a few lines of code. Such solution should work in the meantime:
```gdscript
extends Label

func _on_button_pressed() -> void:
        prints("Label font size:", get_theme_font_size("font_size", "Label"))
        theme.set_font_size("font_size", "Label", 24)
        await theme_changed
        await get_tree().process_frame
        prints("Label font size:", get_theme_font_size("font_size", "Label"))
```

Or with deferred wait:
```gdscript
extends Label

signal theme_changed_deferred

func _ready():
        connect("theme_changed", _on_theme_changed, CONNECT_DEFERRED)

func _on_theme_changed():
        emit_signal("theme_changed_deferred")

func _on_button_pressed() -> void:
        prints("Label font size:", get_theme_font_size("font_size", "Label"))
        theme.set_font_size("font_size", "Label", 24)
        await theme_changed_deferred
        prints("Label font size:", get_theme_font_size("font_size", "Label"))
```

These workarounds are very helpful. I appreciate the investigation work as this issue has been plaguing me. My previous workaround was basically manually logging theme changes and checking if a theme change was queued every physics frame in the UI root node.
